name: Saliva
doc: Saliva (Abyss Worm's enemy attack): the master and the main task - the saliva spat from the caster's mouth: its mesh, strings, sprays and splats, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag138_saliva.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The saliva spat from the caster's mouth: its mesh, strings, sprays and splats, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the main task

params.label: A
params.doc: The prim-model layout a (its models' animation)

params.label: B
params.doc: The prim-model layout b (its models' animation)

params.label: C
params.doc: The prim-model layout c (its models' animation)

params.label: Spray
params.doc: The sprite sequence spray (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Splat
params.doc: The sprite sequence splat (a flipbook of 13 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Main model
params.doc: The prim model main (a mesh of 108 vertices, 72 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Drip steps
params.doc: Each drop's y step by its point (48 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

not_editable.label: Point
not_editable.doc: Caster bone point (x, y, z, bone 13)
